text.en:
30th. DECEMBER, 2017 No. S 92

ALLIED HEALTH PROFESSIONS OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM ORDER, 2017 IS 1012017) Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section l(1) of the Allied Health Professions of Brunei Darussalam Order, 2017, the Minister of Health, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, has appointed 1st July, 2017 as the date on which that Order shall be deemed to have commenced. Dated this 12th. day of Rabiulakhir, 1439 Hijriah corresponding to the 30th. day of December, 2017.

AWANG HAJI ABDUL MANAP BIN OTHMAN Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Health, Brunei Darussalam.
